title: WordLookupResult
description:
Top-level result of `lookup()`.

For Polish this always contains exactly one `StressReading` (Polish stress is near-deterministic).  For Ukrainian there may be multiple readings (heteronyms and variative stress).  `readings` is empty only for words completely absent from all sources.

readings.description: All stress variants.  Always one element for Polish.

MorphReading.description:
One morphological reading of a word form.

Follows [Universal Dependencies](https://universaldependencies.org/) naming. Polish currently provides no morphological data, so `pos`, `feats`, and `lemma` are always empty / `None` here.  The type is shared with the Ukrainian engine (`ua-stress-engine`) for cross-engine API parity.

definition.description: Short sense label from Wiktionary used to disambiguate homographs (e.g. "castle" vs "lock" for Ukrainian «замок»).  Empty for Polish.

feats.description: UD feature map, e.g. `{"Case": ["Nom"], "Number": ["Sing"]}`.  Empty for Polish.

pos.description: UD POS tags, e.g. `["NOUN"]`.  Empty for Polish.

StressReading.description:
One stress variant of a word form.

Part of [`WordLookupResult`].  Mirrors `StressReading` in the Ukrainian engine so both engines can be consumed with the same client code.

confidence.description: How the stress was determined: `"exact"` | `"rule"` | `"default"`. `None` for Ukrainian (all entries are confirmed dictionary forms).

ipa.description: Full IPA string from the G2P pipeline.

ipaSyllables.description: IPA per syllable.  The stressed syllable is prefixed with `ˈ`. Empty for zero-syllable words.

morph.description: Morphological analyses sharing this stress position.  Empty for Polish.

stressFromEnd.description: 1-based position from the end (2 = penultimate, 3 = antepenultimate). `0` for zero-syllable words.

stressedForm.description: Form with a combining acute U+0301 after the stressed vowel. Equal to `form` when there is no vowel to mark.

syllableCount.description: Total number of syllables.  `0` for purely consonantal words.

syllableIndex.description: 0-based index of the stressed syllable from the start of the word. `0` for zero-syllable (purely consonantal) words like "z" or "w".

tokens.description: Token-level phonetic detail.  Empty for Polish.

wordSyllables.description: Grapheme syllables, positionally aligned with `ipa_syllables`. Empty for zero-syllable words.
